usedFor: TimelinesAI holds uploaded files, and Slack gets a direct message when “New Uploaded File” runs “Send Direct Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Uploaded File” in TimelinesAI, then “Send Direct Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: Whoever you choose hears about each upload in Slack, so a file does not wait unnoticed.

watchOut: “New Uploaded File” in TimelinesAI is polling, so “Send Direct Message” follows a scheduled check.
